title: NLO PP-0410/0415 LL Flow Interlock Change

fields.latestPosition: Email sent with proposal. Waiting for reply 27/08 BR. PCS to remove interlock, Tx too unreliable. 04/09 PTS to flag with maintenance 04/09. PCS to Implement.
fields.nextAction: PTS to flag transmitter with maintenance; PCS to implement
fields.why:
NLO Fines pumps PP-0410/415 have a process interlock to stop the pump at LL Flow.
The travel on this line is ~200m and stopping the pump if the flow meter fails increases the risk of blockages.
Plant feed does not share this same interlock.
fields.design:
Remove the interlock that risks pump blockages to plant feed conveyor.
Remove the following interlocks:
- 160-PP-0410: 160-FIT-0410: Fines Pump Discharge Flow Low Low Alarm Healthy.
- 160-PP-0415: 160-FIT-0410: Fines Pump Discharge Flow Low Low Alarm Healthy.
Addition of interlock to
- 150-FE-0310 HPGR Circuit Group Interlock:
 - 160-FIT-0410: Fines Pump Discharge Flow Low Low Alarm Healthy
fields.impact: Fines pumps will no longer stop on low-low flow; a 160-FIT-0410 low-low flow will instead stop the 150-FE-0310 HPGR circuit group.
